title: generate_p2p_token params
description: Adds a P2P token to the running p2p server, which registers it with its broker, and refreshes it, from its punch socket. With peer_pub_b64 the token is the static token derived from both keys, returned as it is when the server has it already; without it, a new random token is added on every call, so that each peer gets a token of its own that can be removed alone. Fails with p2p_server_not_running when no p2p server runs, with broker_addr_mismatch when broker_addr is not the server's broker, and with p2p_token_limit while the server registers 8 tokens, its own included: the broker drops REGISTERs from one address past its quota, so more tokens would lapse while listed. remove_p2p_token makes room.

broker_addr.description: Broker address. Must be the broker_addr the p2p server was started with.

peer_pub_b64.description: Base64-encoded public key of the peer to derive a static token for. A p2p server whose tokens are all static admits only their peers: a session whose peer has another key is closed before session_started. A random token, the server's own included, admits any peer.
